title: Typed failure
description: The component detecting a failure reports it accurately with redacted actionable detail; the control plane decides lifecycle consequences. Command disposition, side-effect certainty, technical category, and retry advice stay separate. An unknown mapping fails closed as the internal category with retry never.

category.description: The closed technical category describing the cause.

code.description: The stable, area-defined reason code inside the category, for example stale_target or unsupported_participant_environment. Codes are additive within a category.

message.description: Redacted, actionable operator-facing detail. It never contains the rejected product value, a secret, or a credential.

retry.description: Advice to the caller. Adapters retry only when idempotency, reconciliation, or proof of no side effect makes it safe.

retry_after_ms.description: Minimum delay before another attempt. Required when retry is after_delay, forbidden otherwise; jitter and durable budgets are the caller's.

retry_condition.description: The condition that must change first, for example observation_path_ready. Required when retry is after_condition_change, forbidden otherwise.

provider.description: Present only when a provider produced the underlying error.

details.description: Structured, redacted diagnostic fields such as stage, watermark, or affected stream identity.
details.$comment: extension-point: the reporting component defines its own redacted diagnostic fields.

technical_category.description: Closed set. Product outcomes such as no implementation, terminal unvalidated completion, cancellation, and Sensitive Account escalation are lifecycle results and never appear here.

oneOf.title: Authentication
oneOf.description: A credential, token, signature, or webhook authenticity check failed, including ingress credential rejection.

oneOf.title: Authorization
oneOf.description: The authenticated principal lacks the required membership, scope, or lane, including an unauthorized telemetry query.

oneOf.title: Policy denied
oneOf.description: A pinned client configuration release, Sensitive Account classification, platform invariant, or case stop denied the work. Deny always wins.

oneOf.title: Validation
oneOf.description: An envelope, payload, or normalization check rejected the input as structurally or semantically invalid.

oneOf.title: Incompatible version
oneOf.description: A required envelope, payload, or component contract major is unsupported. There is no lower-fidelity substitution.

oneOf.title: Not found
oneOf.description: A referenced record or artifact is missing, expired, redacted, or deleted.

oneOf.title: Conflict
oneOf.description: An expected revision, fencing token, target revision, uniqueness constraint, or duplicate check lost. The effect is absent.

oneOf.title: Integrity
oneOf.description: Stored or streamed content contradicts its recorded digest, size, type, or sequence, including an unrecoverable source gap.

oneOf.title: Timeout
oneOf.description: A bounded window, deadline, lease, or provider call elapsed without a definitive outcome.

oneOf.title: Rate limited
oneOf.description: A transient quota, backpressure limit, or provider rate limit applied. Ingestion never samples or silently drops eligible telemetry to stay under quota.

oneOf.title: Payload too large
oneOf.description: A fixed platform ceiling on bytes, records, spans, nesting, or attribute count was exceeded. This is a permanent rejection, unlike transient backpressure.

oneOf.title: Provider unavailable
oneOf.description: A provider or backing store is unreachable, degraded, or circuit-broken. Work requiring that role pauses; there is no silent substitute.

oneOf.title: Provider rejected
oneOf.description: A provider definitively refused the operation, mapped from its raw error by the owning adapter.

oneOf.title: Budget exhausted
oneOf.description: A durable revision, execution, contact, or credit-issuance allowance is spent. Reclassification and recovery never reset consumption.

oneOf.title: Capacity exhausted
oneOf.description: No prepared preview runtime, worker slot, or shed-load capacity is currently available. The resource is absent rather than the budget spent.

oneOf.title: Readiness incomplete
oneOf.description: A required readiness boundary is unmet: extension binding, SDK path, trace correlation, target freshness, dataset, or exact candidate readiness.

oneOf.title: Configuration
oneOf.description: Local configuration or a client integration setting is missing or incompatible, so no provider call was made. Client onboarding reports these as actionable setup errors rather than provider failures.

oneOf.title: Internal
oneOf.description: A uTrace defect or an unmapped provider error. It fails closed and creates an engineering-visible finding.

retry_advice.description: Retry advice is separate from the disposition and from side-effect certainty.

oneOf.title: Never
oneOf.description: Repeating cannot succeed. Uncertain or partially applied external effects go to reconciliation instead of repetition.

oneOf.title: After delay
oneOf.description: The same request may be repeated after retry_after_ms, under durable budgets, jittered backoff, and the idempotency key.

oneOf.title: After condition change
oneOf.description: Repeating is pointless until retry_condition changes, for example readiness returning or a lease being reacquired.

provider_name.description: An active provider from the architecture's provider lookup.

provider_error.description: The provider's own error identity, kept scoped. Reconciliation uses stable provider identity rather than blind repetition.
